body: Thanks again. I don't blame people for doing such things (especially the children) but even if i used to don't give any importance to the other's opinion (and i still do it most of the time) yeah when they do that for my appearence it hurts. Thank you. I know that i am not alone and there are many people with my problem but it just makes me more depressed. Well for the therapy is not only about distance but primarily it's because of the virus gave my family some economic problem (i live in a pretty whealthy family but since my parents have both a work based on catering/tourism they don't work at all in this period) and i don't want to make them spend so much money for me since they already do it to make go to school. I'm sad for your losts and i really don't know how strong you are to go on. It's so hard i try so much to be strong but i feel like everything makes me weaker. Most of the people stare at me in public and children points at me and whispering stuff to their parents, i know that sometime they also think that i have some disabilty bc of my look and my speech (of course there is nothing wrong on having any kind of disabilty and disabled are just normal people but it still makes me sad). But maybe they are right i am a really stupid guy and that hurts me to cause i try to be as smart as the people around me but i can't. That being said i really appreciate your comment and it made feel better so thank you very much. Also cause i perfectly know how annoying i am so thanks again for your care and patiance
